coaching.headline: Our best trio game — towers 10-5, objectives 20-15, and Cuban's Sparrow leading our side with 42766 hero damage.
coaching.team: Everything clicked: Cuban's Sparrow went 12/4, Willy's Steel put up 68711 mitigated and 18 assists, and Xeebs' Gideon won the favored mid read. Out-towered 10-5 and closed it. This is the shape that wins — carry pressure, a frontline that glues fights, and map control.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Bank the formula — Sparrow carrying plus Willy peeling plus map control — and tighten the one leak: only 1 of 5 won fights cashed, and the 24.6 and 27.3 losses came while players ahead in lane stayed home.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow carry, 12/4 — a ceiling game even with the lane read unfavored vs Kira. The win condition.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Steel support, 18 assists and huge mitigation as the frontline — the peel that let the carry pop and the team out-tower them 10-5. Keep fronting and gluing the fights like this.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Gideon mid won a favored read into Neon — 2/4/8 with 25791 hero damage that helped out-tower them 10-5.

threats: Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
ourKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
ourKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
ourKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
enemyKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

greystone.loadout: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity), augment Close Cut, crest Iceskorn Talons
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,388 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Greystone jungle players this patch (29% of the team's). The damage came from Sky Splitter, Draconum, Mutilator.
Stone Forged Soul at rank 3: 145s base, about 96.7s by the end (33% shorter) from 50 ability haste: Basilisk 20, Draconum 15, Mutilator 15.
14 takedowns (12 kills, 2 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Greystone dealt 47,192 hero damage, 29% of their team's, with +177 physical power from items.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.
Mutilator (item): On Successsful Basic Attacks: Deal 1% of their Max Health as Damage.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
Close Cut (augment): Make Way deals 20% increased damage to the nearest Enemy Unit.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; 16% omnivamp; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 14,229 healing recorded.
Toughness: +400 health, +40 physical armor; took 59,554 damage, mitigated 39,849, died 8 times.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 5 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Draconum, Mutilator, Iceskorn Talons, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Mutilator, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Damage that scales with our health): 2 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Mutilator. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on our side fed them.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (healing off the damage; every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.

Countered? 3 of the 5 players Greystone killed built physical armor (Shinbi, Steel, Sevarog). Anti-heal on Sparrow, Shinbi, Steel. Health items on Shinbi, Steel, Sevarog raised the %-health damage they took. We killed Greystone 8 times.
Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 42.3% in 414 Greystone jungle games, below the hero's 47.6%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

card.lesson: Stone Forged Soul came back about every 97s instead of 145s by the end (33% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
